title: Applicable law and forum
description: State / ADR / traditional-jurisdiction recourse layer. Identifies the body of law governing the order and, optionally, the named adjudication venue and proceedings language. Provider-agnostic by construction: every field is a free-form string whose pattern enforces SHAPE only — the named external standard (ISO 3166 for jurisdiction, ISO 639 / BCP 47 for language) remains the source of truth, and the clause never holds a closed list of jurisdictions, forums, or languages. Compose with `figaro-arbitration-kleros` (or another `figaro-arbitration-<provider>`) to add a decentralized ODR layer.

fields.name: applicableLaw
fields.label: Applicable law
fields.description: Identifier for the body of law that governs the contract. Conventionally an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'NL', 'JP'), optionally with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g. 'US-CA', 'CA-ON'); 'EU' for European Union law; 'INTL' for international / treaty law. Free-form for non-state legal orders (e.g. 'Sharia', 'ICANN-UDRP'). The pattern admits a hyphen-joined alphanumeric token that starts with a letter — it enforces shape only, never a fixed list of jurisdictions; the cited standard is the source of truth.

fields.name: forum
fields.label: Adjudication forum
fields.description: Named adjudication venue (e.g. 'JAMS-arbitration', 'AAA-arbitration', 'ICC-arbitration', 'us-federal-court', 'small-claims-court', or a spelled-out court such as 'Courts of England and Wales'). OMIT the field to mean: courts of competent jurisdiction within applicableLaw — absence, not a stored blank.

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language of proceedings
fields.description: Language for adjudication proceedings as an ISO 639-1 two-letter code (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'zh', 'ar') or ISO 639-2 three-letter code (e.g. 'eng'), optionally with a BCP 47 region or script subtag (e.g. 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hant'). OMIT the field to mean: official language of the forum.
